elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The clause provides a USD 2,000,000 CGL "primary limits" amount but does not specify a per-occurrence limit.

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: The clause provides a USD 2,000,000 CGL "primary limits" amount but does not expressly establish a USD 2,000,000 aggregate limit.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added text states only USD 1,000,000 and, as a standalone fragment after subsection B, does not impose a duty on M&I to maintain that coverage.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The rendered language does not demonstrate that M&I does not process Customer Data. It states only USD 2,000,000 and the standalone fragment does not impose a maintenance duty.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: Subsection A.3 requires M&I throughout the Term to maintain Workers' Compensation Insurance as mandated or allowed by the state where Services are performed.

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: Subsection B requires certificates at execution and annually thereafter at Customer's request, not generally whenever requested.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Although the appended fragment identifies USD 1,000,000 of E&O insurance, it appears after subsection B and contains no operative verb requiring M&I to obtain or maintain it.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Although the appended fragment identifies USD 2,000,000 of cyber and privacy insurance, it contains no operative verb requiring M&I to obtain or maintain it.
